idea: Instagram reels editing for cafes near campus in Dehradun

strategist.problem: A cafe owner within 3 km of campus has a phone full of raw clips from the weekend rush and no edited reel to post; the pain hits on Monday morning when the Instagram grid is 3 weeks stale and the owner sees a competitor cafe's reel going around the campus WhatsApp groups instead.
strategist.target_customer: Owner or manager of an independent cafe within 3 km of a Dehradun college campus, doing ₹3-10 lakh monthly revenue with no in-house marketing staff, who already films clips on a phone but never has time to edit and post them consistently.
strategist.mission: We edit and schedule Instagram reels for campus-adjacent Dehradun cafes so the owner never has to open an editing app again.

competitors.name: Local Dehradun boutique social media agencies
competitors.differentiator: They quote ₹15,000+ monthly retainers built for bigger brands; we sell a single-campus package a cafe owner can approve over WhatsApp in one message.

competitors.name: Freelance video editors on Fiverr/Upwork
competitors.differentiator: They need briefs, files and revision loops in English; we already know the cafe's menu, lighting and campus slang and shoot-edit-post in one loop.

competitors.name: A junior in-house hire or the owner's nephew editing on CapCut
competitors.differentiator: A part-time helper posts 1 reel a week and quits in exam season; we guarantee a fixed weekly reel count all year.

scope_cuts: No custom SaaS or client dashboard — delivery is Google Drive folders, WhatsApp and Instagram itself; building software would eat the 15 hours/week before a single cafe pays.
No photo shoots, branding, logo or menu design — only reels editing and posting, because extra service lines dilute the one thing campus cafes will pay a repeatable monthly fee for.
No hiring an editor or expanding beyond cafes in the first 6 weeks — the founder edits personally until 3 cafes pay, so quality and process are proven before payroll.

mvp_features: Weekly Reel Pack — 4 reels per month: founder receives raw clips via WhatsApp, edits to 9:16 with Hinglish captions, writes 3 hook options, delivers final MP4 + caption + 8 hashtags via Google Drive, owner approves over WhatsApp, founder posts 2 reels/week on the cafe's Instagram
Per-Reel Sprint — 1 reel delivered within 48 hours of clip receipt, single revision round, for cafes testing before a monthly commitment
Launch Pilot Pack — discounted first-month package of 4 reels plus a 15-clip raw footage shoot at the cafe, used to build the first 3 case studies

first_10_steps: List every cafe within 3 km of campus by walking the two main food streets and pulling Google Maps results, and write them into a Google Sheet with owner name, Instagram handle and footfall notes — target 20 cafes
Post 2 sample reels on a new Instagram business account using stock-free footage shot at a friend's canteen, edited in VN Video Editor with Whisper captions, to have a visible portfolio link
Buy the .in domain at ₹75/mo and publish the one-page Carrd site with the 2 sample reels, the 3-package list and a WhatsApp click-to-chat button
Send 20 WhatsApp Business messages to the listed cafe owners with a 20-second screen-recorded teardown of their stale grid and one free reel offer
Search Fiverr for 3 Indian video editors with cafe/food reel portfolios, shortlist 2, and agree a fixed per-reel rate in writing (message or Fiverr order note) before any paid customer arrives

Order 1 paid test reel from the shortlisted Fiverr editor using raw clips from the friend's canteen, review caption quality and 9:16 export, and keep the one who passes as named overflow capacity for exam weeks
Deliver 3 free reels to the 3 most responsive owners within 7 days to capture before/after screenshots for case studies
Write the proposal and 1-page service contract in Google Docs covering reel count, revision limit, posting days and payment terms, and save as a Canva PDF template
Set up the Razorpay dashboard and create the first payment link for the discounted Launch Pilot Pack, test with a ₹1 UPI payment
Shoot and edit the first Launch Pilot Pack for the most interested cafe, delivering 4 reels in week 1 to lock in the case study

key_assumptions: Cafe owners within 3 km of a Dehradun campus will pay ₹3,500/month for 4 posted reels because a local agency quotes ₹15,000+ and an in-house helper is unreliable in exam season — assumption, not a verified market fact.

Delivery cost per customer is ₹1,200/month = 2 overflow reels at ₹600 each to a Fiverr editor during exam weeks; founder's own time is not costed. Weekly Reel Pack tier capped at 3 simultaneous customers until a second editor is proven.
Avg revenue per customer of ₹3,500 assumes most paying cafes land on the Weekly Reel Pack monthly tier; Per-Reel Sprint and Launch Pilot Pack buyers are blended in.
Starting capital ₹20,000 is the founder's own savings (within the ₹5,000-₹25,000 stated range); no external funding.

channels.name: Instagram DM + WhatsApp walk-in to 20 campus cafes
channels.tactic: Build a list of 20 cafes within 3 km of campus on Instagram Maps. Each day, DM the cafe's Instagram account from the founder's personal handle: open their profile, note the last post date, send the 3-line cold message with one free reel edit of their own clips. Follow up on WhatsApp after 48 hours. Volume: 4 DMs/day Mon-Sat = 24/week. In-person: 5 walk-ins/week (Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat, Sun) with a phone showing a sample reel and a printed one-pager. Treat the first 30 days as list-building + free-reel volume (target: 10 free reels delivered) rather than a hard 1-customer close target. ₹0 spend.

channels.name: Campus WhatsApp groups + college fest club shoutouts
channels.tactic: Post in 6 class/hostel WhatsApp groups and 2 college fest committee groups (Dehradun campus): one message per group per week offering the Launch Pilot Pack at ₹2,500 to any cafe near campus, plus ask 2 club conveners to forward to their batch groups. Deliver 3 free reels to 3 cafes first so the group has a real reel to share. ₹0 spend.

first_10_customers: Day 1-3: Write down 20 cafes within 3 km of campus from Instagram Maps + Google Maps, with handle, last-post date, follower count. This is the whole pipeline.

Day 4-7: Pick 3 cafes with a stale grid (last post 10+ days ago), download 5 of their own public clips, edit 1 free reel each with Hinglish captions, send it as an MP4 with the 3-line cold message. Ask only for a 10-minute WhatsApp call if they like it.

Day 8-14: Convert the best 1 free-reel response into the Launch Pilot Pack at ₹2,500 via Razorpay payment link. Simultaneously DM 4 new cafes/day from the list and complete 5 in-person walk-ins with the sample reel on phone.

Day 15-21: Ask pilot cafe owner for a 1-line WhatsApp forward to 2 other cafe owners they know near campus. Send the same cold message to cafes 6-12 on the list. Post the delivered reel (with permission) on founder's own Instagram with campus-specific caption.
Day 22-30: Push 3 free reels as case studies into 2 college fest committee WhatsApp groups and 6 class/hostel groups. Convert 1 response to Weekly Reel Pack at ₹3,500.
Day 31-45: Repeat DM loop on cafes 13-20, ask both paying cafes for a WhatsApp forward to 1 cafe owner each, and offer the Per-Reel Sprint at ₹800 as a no-commitment trial to 5 hesitant owners.
growth.cold_message: Saw your last Instagram post was 3 weeks ago while your weekend rush clips are sitting unedited — I edited one reel from your own public clips, here's the MP4: [link]. I do reels for cafes near [campus name] — 4 reels a month posted for you, ₹3,500, approval over WhatsApp. Free sample, no call needed — want me to send a second one from your menu clips?

objections.objection: I already have my nephew editing reels on CapCut for free.
objections.response: Great — keep him. I'm not replacing him, I'm guaranteeing 2 posts a week all year including your exam season and summer when he's busy. Try 1 reel free this week; if it doesn't get more views than his, don't pay me anything.

objections.objection: ₹3,500/month is too much, I can't commit without seeing results.
objections.response: Start with the Per-Reel Sprint: ₹800 for 1 reel delivered in 48 hours, one revision, you post it yourself. If it doesn't bring you at least a few new faces mentioning the reel, you never buy again — no monthly lock-in.

critic.verdict: The plan is a coherent, constraint-respecting service business: reels editing for campus cafes sold over WhatsApp with UPI payments, built on free tools and a ₹20,000 savings budget. Pricing (₹800/₹2,500/₹3,500) sits in the realistic range for Indian small local businesses and the delivery model matches a 15-hour/week student founder. The main gap is in the growth playbook's volume assumptions versus the actual hours available, but nothing here would derail the founder.
critic.biggest_risk: Cafe owners near campus are notoriously price-sensitive and relationship-driven; a student with no portfolio may deliver 10 free reels and still convert zero to paid because owners treat free work as a favor, not a signal — leaving the founder with spent hours and no revenue by week 6.
